Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the third step (the Planner's analysis after the first Ghar Ki Rani search), the Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results. The search results clearly showed a 1940 film and a 1945 film. Instead of recognizing these as the actual release years, the Planner hallucinated a "canonical year" of 2007 based on a misinterpretation of "first-listed entry" (likely confusing the IMDb ID or a different data point with the year). This led to the false conclusion that Ghar Ki Rani (2007) was released after Heaven Help Us (1985), whereas the correct answer is that Ghar Ki Rani (1940) was released first.
